title: (ZoomIt) right-clicking while drawing in live-zoom does strange things
summary: Right-click in ZoomIt live-zoom drawing mode can leave the display zoomed, non-interactive, and the pointer hidden; the report also notes an occasional recovery to normal desktop with the pointer still missing.

judgment.rationale: The issue gives a concrete ZoomIt transition to reproduce and reports a safety-relevant pointer/input recovery failure; the exact current exit path remains unverified.
evidence: The report specifies live zoom -> drawing-without-zoom hotkey -> right-click on PowerToys 0.88.0.
A second report describes pointer loss after live zoom but does not confirm the same transition.
Current ZoomIt UI tests cover Escape from draw-without-zoom, not right-click during live-zoom drawing.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the exact right-click transition and verify pointer restoration before considering a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: The transition-state failure is plausible from the observed hidden pointer and non-interactivity, but requires current reproduction.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore cursor and interaction state on live-zoom draw exit
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A right-click transition out of live-zoom drawing may leave cursor hiding or input capture active after the mode change.
plan: Reproduce the exact right-click transition and trace drawing/live-zoom exit handlers plus cursor visibility restoration.
Make exit and fallback paths restore the pointer and the expected interaction mode even if the transition is interrupted.
Add a regression test for right-click from live-zoom drawing and verify the desktop remains interactive.
verification: Repeat the reported sequence on current stable and verify return to live zoom, visible pointer and working desktop input; exercise repeated right-click and other supported exit keys.

confidence.rationale: The report is concrete, but the current transition handler and the related #38669 symptom are not proven identical.

issue_context.summary: Right-click in ZoomIt live-zoom drawing mode can leave the display zoomed, non-interactive, and the pointer hidden; the report also notes an occasional recovery to normal desktop with the pointer still missing.
known_information: The report identifies PowerToys 0.88.0 and gives the sequence live zoom, drawing-without-zoom hotkey, then right-click.
The reported expected behavior is return to live zoom; observed behavior can leave a hidden pointer and non-interactive screen.
A second user reports a separate invisible-pointer symptom after exiting live zoom; the issue is not confirmed identical.
inferences: The right-click transition may not restore cursor visibility and the live-zoom interaction mode atomically; the exact current handler is unverified.
issue_context.analysis: The report is specific enough for a maintainer reproduction, and the pointer/input-loss consequence makes the transition worth checking. Existing ZoomIt UI coverage exercises Escape from draw-without-zoom, not this right-click transition.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue and sole comment; the original reporter could not reproduce the rare full desktop recovery, while a second user described pointer loss after live zoom.

Current main at 6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0 has a draw-without-zoom Escape UI test, but it does not cover right-click during live-zoom drawing. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0/src/modules/ZoomIt/Tests/ZoomIt.UITests/ZoomItTests.cs#L187-L208
Related issue #38669 also reports pointer loss while exiting live-zoom drawing; it is closed, but not a proven fix for this right-click transition. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/38669

actions.label: Approve Restore cursor and interaction state on live-zoom draw exit
Reproduce right-click exit from live-zoom drawing

reproduce.title: Verify ZoomIt right-click exit and pointer restoration
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable; original report used PowerToys 0.88.0
prerequisites: Windows 10; the original report was through RDP, so compare direct and RDP sessions if available.
Enable ZoomIt live zoom and configure its drawing-without-zoom hotkey.
setup: Enable ZoomIt live zoom and drawing-without-zoom shortcut.
steps: Use the drawing-without-zoom hotkey to enter drawing mode.
Right-click once and observe zoom state, pointer visibility, and whether desktop input remains interactive.
If the pointer disappears, try the reported left-click and second right-click recovery sequence.
reproduce.expected_result: Right-click should return to live zoom with a visible pointer and interactive desktop; no restart or sign-out should be needed.
